categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in ecological environment comprehensive remediation, including solid waste pollution control and resource utilization, sewage and water environment comprehensive treatment, soil and groundwater remediation, and photovoltaic energy. It provides integrated environmental solutions encompassing design, equipment manufacturing, project construction, and operation services primarily for local governments and large enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include solid waste pollution barrier and remediation systems, sludge high-dry dehydration and carbonization treatment, integrated river and lake sediment treatment, rural sewage membrane symbiosis treatment, modular village sewage treatment systems, soil steam thermal desorption, and multiphase groundwater extraction systems. The company also develops advanced CO2 capture and conversion technologies, sludge pyrolysis carbonization, and innovative photovoltaic system solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are local government departments and their subordinate units, as well as large enterprises. The company serves markets in solid waste landfill remediation, municipal and industrial wastewater treatment, rural sewage ecological governance, and emerging photovoltaic energy sectors, with projects mainly in China’s Anhui province and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a strong presence in Anhui province including cities like Hefei, Huainan, Huaibei, Bengbu, Lu’an, Huangshan, Suzhou, Anqing, and Wuhu. It also has projects and subsidiaries in over 20 provinces and cities nationwide and has begun exporting photovoltaic equipment to Europe, America, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection industry supply chain, providing integrated environmental solutions from design and equipment manufacturing to project construction and operation services. It also manufactures key equipment components in-house, ensuring quality and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening environmental governance and solid waste resource utilization, expanding into new energy and new materials, and developing carbon-neutral and negative carbon technologies. The company emphasizes R&D in CO2 capture and conversion, sludge treatment, and photovoltaic energy, maintaining strong collaboration with universities and research institutes to drive innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based sales of environmental solutions via bidding and negotiation, operation service fees under BOT, BOO, and entrusted operation models, and sales of photovoltaic energy products. The company also earns income from equipment manufacturing and technology licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China’s ecological protection and environmental governance industry, especially in solid waste and water pollution treatment sectors. It holds a strong competitive position in Anhui province and nationally, recognized as a top enterprise in landfill remediation, rural sewage treatment, and sludge processing, competing with other specialized environmental technology firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.6 billion, a 7.35% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 21.7 million, down 31.45% mainly due to increased bad debt provisions. Total assets reached RMB 3.09 billion, growing 12.16%, indicating steady scale expansion despite profit fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers customized, technology-driven integrated environmental solutions combining proprietary core technologies and patented equipment. Its value lies in comprehensive service capabilities from design to operation, strong R&D innovation, and a robust project execution track record, enabling high-quality, sustainable environmental remediation and renewable energy solutions tailored to client needs.
